notes.title: CINEVR 4.0 is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Brace yourselves, CINEVR v4.0 is here!

[b]PUBLIC SCREENINGS[/b]
Each week, 4 movies in theaters (2D and 3D) every evening at 9 p.m CET.

[b]60+ PREMIUM MOVIES ON DEMAND[/b]
Explore the largest catalog of movies on demand in virtual reality!
+60 movies are available in 2D and 3D, most of them in several languages and with subtitles.
Watch movies alone or create a private room to watch movies with your friends!

[b]AMAZING IMAGE QUALITY[/b]
Movies on demand are encoded by us in 1080p with a very high bitrate to offer the best image quality in VR.

[b]SPATIALIZED AUDIO[/b]
Whatever the number of audio channels, all our environments surround you with spatialized 360° sound.

[b]SOCIAL AND CROSS PLATFORM[/b]
Create or join private/public rooms to watch videos with up to 9 people regardless of your VR headset (Oculus Go, Samsung Gear VR, Oculus Rift and HTC Vive).
Send emojis and chat to interact with your friends and other people.

[b]PLAYER WITH LARGE AUDIO/VIDEO SUPPORT[/b]
Our player is compatible with a large number of audio and video codecs, video formats (HD, Full HD and 4K) and video types (2D, 3D-Side by Side, 3D-TopBottom, 180 °, 360 °).

[b]LOCAL VIDEOS[/b]
Play videos from your computer or your home network (SMB). Audio tracks and subtitles are automatically recognized by our player.

[b]THEMATIC SCENES[/b]
Personalize your experience with our 6 thematic scenes:
[list]
[*] Movie theater
[*] Beach in the moonlight
[*] 60s drive-in
[*] Scary haunted house
[*] Spaceship
[*] Antic theater
[/list]

Happy watching!
The CINEVR team

notes.title: CINEVR 3.1.2 is here!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that CINEVR 3.1.2 is now available on Steam!

[h1] Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Sceneries: we are introducing sceneries events, animations and audios that increase the immersive feeling. (Beach, Spaceship and Mansion)
[*] Avatars: added a new pinch gesture that matches to Oculus gestures guidelines.
[/list] 
    
[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
    [*] Sceneries: fixed white screen when arriving in a scenery.
    [*] Sceneries: fixed lighting quality in beach and mansion sceneries.
    [*] Audios: fixed all sceneries audios sources can be muted in audio panel.
    [*] UI: various user interface bugs fixed
[/list]

Happy watching!
The CINEVR team

notes.title: CINEVR v3.1 is available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30318585/d99c5230ae53ff8db054e91d761720690687c1c5.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Brace yourselves, CINEVR v3.1 is here! 

First, a brand new premium 3D environment, spaceship, has been added and is available for purchase. You will enjoy it if you wanna watch a sci-fi or space opera movie.

Next, we are thrilled to introduce premium VOD on CINEVR. Using your popcorn credits, it is now possible to rent videos. 

Available at launch, "[url=https://www.targostories.com/south-pole-targo-vr]Solo to the South Pole[/url]", a documentary made by Targo Studios and Ushuaia TV, available in French and English languages. Lots of new content will be progressively added in  the next months, and hopefully, movies :-)

And finally, here's a list of bugfixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed the seat arrows that sometimes remain lit when hovering with laser pointer
[*] Big codebase revamp that lays the groundwork for a major version coming soon
[*] Upgraded engine to Unity 2018.4
[*] Fixed a Skybox glitch during transition between popcorn selection and native store
[/list]

Happy watching!
The CINEVR team

notes.title: CINEVR v3.0 is available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30318585/d99c5230ae53ff8db054e91d761720690687c1c5.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

We are delighted to announce [b]CINEVR v3.0[/b] with a lot of new features and improvements!

[list]
[*] "Void", a customized player (size, position) to watch content alone,
[*] 3 new premium sceneries : "Beach", "Drive-in", and "Haunted house"
[*] New cross-platform account system to register with an email and a password,
[*] Support for Windows Mixed Reality headsets
[*] Local file explorer now supports SMB network shares
[*] New environment selection UI
[*] Improved rendering performance and increased eye resolution texture for sharper graphics
[*] Improved voice volume: users can be muted per-person, and voice is now correctly muted with volume set at zero
[/list]

App will keep being improved further this year. Meanwhile, feel free to contact us on Reddit, Twitter, Facebook and email to tell us what you think!

Cheers,
the CINEVR team

notes.title: Watch Ready Player One in CINEVR!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce that Ready Player One can now be watched on CINEVR ([b]for France only[/b])!
​
How to proceed?
- Rent or purchase Ready Player One in digital format on MyTF1 VOD service here : https://mytf1vod.tf1.fr/films/ready-player-one-44581
- After purchase is completed, you will receive a redeem code by email
- Make sure CINEVR is updated to the latest version.
- Open CINEVR and enter the redeem code in the Ready Player One menu.

Enjoy the movie!
The CINEVR team

notes.title: CINEVR 2.1 is available
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that version [b]2.1[/b] of CINEVR is available on Steam, with new features added:

[list]
[*] New avatars with controllable hands and head
[*] Audio chat with people in the theater
[*] Private rooms with friends invitation using Facebook Connect
[*] Better-looking, less intrusive laser pointer
[*] Sharper textures
[*] Improvements on UI
[/list]

Thank you so much for all the feedbacks and positive requests you sent us. We’ve been reading all of them meticulously.

For the past 2 years now, the team has been working very hard on this project and we have amazing ideas for the future. We'll release a lot more new features this year, so stay tuned!

So if you love what we are doing with CINEVR, feel free to spread the word on Twitter!

Also, the official website has been updated with all new download links for others VR devices: https://cinevr.io/

Happy watching!
The CINEVR team

notes.title: CINEVR 2.0.1 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are pleased to announce that version [b]2.0.1[/b] of CINEVR is available on Steam! 
It fixes major issues reported by our users, and adds a few improvements:

[list]
    [*]FIX: Unable to play videos
    [*]FIX: Bad framerate caused by ambient lighting system
    [*]FIX: Files on local videos folder are not all listed
    [*]ADD: Support for H265/HEVC video formats (may require installation of a codec from Microsoft)
[/list]

Happy watching!
The CINEVR team
